t: This is Glenkerry House, a fourteen-storey Grade II listed housing block on the Brownfield Estate in Poplar. It was finished in 1977 and designed by the studio of Ernő Goldfinger, rather than by the architect himself. It stands close to Balfron Tower and Carradale House, which Goldfinger did design, and complements their appearance. Inside are seventy-nine flats in all, including four four-bedroom maisonettes on the ground floor.
